category.name: Productivity and workspace
category.description: Email, calendars, files, notes, tasks and project management.

entries.name: Airtable API
entries.free_tier: Free tier: 1,000 API calls per workspace per month on the Free plan, 5 req/sec per base
entries.desc_en: Read and write records in Airtable bases and tables via REST API.
entries.notes: Official JS client available; Python/Ruby/.NET clients are community-maintained.

rate_limits.summary: 5 requests/sec per base; 50 requests/sec per user across PATs; 429 then wait 30s

entries.name: Asana API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <personal access token or OAuth2 token>
entries.free_tier: free tier: API included on Personal (free) plan, rate limited
entries.desc_en: Create tasks, projects, and comments in Asana workspaces via REST API.
entries.notes: Official remote MCP server uses OAuth; MCP tokens work only with the MCP server, not the REST API.

rate_limits.summary: 150 requests/min per token on free domains; 1,500/min on paid domains

entries.name: Atlassian (Jira, Confluence)
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 token> (or basic auth with API token for Cloud REST)
entries.free_tier: free tier: available on Free Jira/Confluence plans; rate limits vary by plan
entries.desc_en: Create and manage Jira issues and Confluence pages via REST API or the official remote MCP server.
entries.notes: Official Atlassian Remote MCP (Rovo) rate limits range 500-10,000+ calls/hour depending on subscription tier; does not store/cache content.

free_plan.quota: Jira Free: up to 10 users, 2 GB storage

rate_limits.summary: Points-based: 65,000 points/hour global pool for apps (API-token traffic not affected); 429 with Retry-After

entries.name: Box API
entries.free_tier: Free: developer plan with 10 GB storage, full API access and 1,000 AI units per month, no payment required
entries.desc_en: Upload, download, and manage files, folders, and metadata in Box via REST API.
entries.notes: Also supports JWT/Client Credentials Grant for server-to-server auth.

free_plan.quota: Free developer plan: 10 GB storage, full API access, 1,000 AI units/month

rate_limits.summary: 1,000 API requests/min per user; uploads 240/min; search 6/sec per user

entries.name: Cal.com API
entries.free_tier: free tier: API included on Free plan, 120 req/min (higher limits on request)
entries.desc_en: Create and manage bookings, event types, and availability via the Cal.com REST API v2.
entries.notes: OAuth strongly recommended for production integrations; API keys are simpler but less secure.

rate_limits.summary: 120 requests/min per API key; can be raised to ~200/min, 800/min possibly at extra cost

entries.name: Calendly API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <personal access token or OAuth2 token>
entries.free_tier: Free: API GET/POST works on every plan incl. Free (except 3 Enterprise-only endpoints); webhooks need a Standard, Teams or Enterprise plan
entries.desc_en: Programmatically book meetings and read/write scheduling, event, and contact data via REST API v2.

entries.name: ClickUp API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: <personal API token> (no Bearer prefix) or OAuth2 token
entries.free_tier: free tier: API access included on Free Forever plan
entries.desc_en: Create and manage ClickUp tasks, lists, and docs via REST API or the official MCP server.
entries.notes: MCP server is OAuth-only (no API keys); Free Forever is limited to 50 MCP calls per 24h without the AI add-on.

free_plan.quota: Free Forever plan: API at 100 requests/min per token

rate_limits.summary: 100 requests/min per token on Free Forever, Unlimited, Business; 1,000 on Business Plus; 10,000 on Enterprise

entries.name: Coda API (Superhuman Docs)
entries.free_tier: free, included for all users on both free and paid workspaces
entries.desc_en: Read and write Coda (now 'Superhuman Docs') documents, tables, and rows via REST API or an MCP server.
entries.notes: Coda was rebranded to 'Superhuman Docs' after Grammarly's acquisition; the API base URL (coda.io/apis/v1) still works. The official MCP server uses OAuth via id.superhuman.com (scope mcp:all).

rate_limits.summary: Reads 100 req/6s; writes 10 req/6s; doc content writes 5 req/10s; list docs 4 req/6s

async_jobs.how: Writes return HTTP 202 with requestId; check GET /mutationStatus/{requestId}

entries.name: Dropbox API
entries.free_tier: free tier: API access included on Basic (free) plan, rate limited
entries.desc_en: Upload, download, and manage files and folders in Dropbox via the HTTP REST API.
entries.notes: Official remote MCP server is in open beta and uses Dropbox OAuth.

entries.name: Google Workspace APIs (Gmail, Calendar, Drive)
entries.free_tier: Free: no charge within per-API daily quotas; Google plans to bill quota overages to the Cloud billing account later in 2026
entries.desc_en: Read/write Gmail messages, Calendar events, and Drive files programmatically via REST APIs.
entries.notes: Each Workspace API (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) has its own quota; sensitive/restricted scopes require OAuth consent screen verification. Official remote MCP servers (Developer Preview, OAuth) run per product, e.g. gmailmcp.googleapis.com/mcp/v1.

free_plan.quota: Gmail API: free up to 80,000,000 quota units/day per project

rate_limits.summary: Gmail: 1,200,000 quota units/min per project, 6,000/min per user; messages.send costs 100 units

entries.name: Linear API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: <API_KEY> (personal key, no Bearer) or Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 token>
entries.free_tier: free tier: API access included on Free plan (rate limited)
entries.desc_en: Create, query, and update Linear issues, projects, and comments via GraphQL API or the official MCP server.
entries.notes: GraphQL API (not REST). Official MCP also has a read-only variant at mcp.linear.app/mcp/readonly.

free_plan.quota: Free plan incl. API and webhook access, 250 issues

rate_limits.summary: API key: 2,500 requests/hour and 3,000,000 complexity points/hour per user; OAuth: 5,000 req/hour

entries.name: Microsoft Graph (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive)
entries.free_tier: free with a Microsoft 365/Entra ID tenant (free dev tenant via Microsoft 365 Developer Program)
entries.desc_en: Single REST endpoint to read/write Outlook mail, Calendar events, Teams, and OneDrive/SharePoint data.
entries.notes: Requires app registration in Microsoft Entra ID; delegated vs application permissions determine required consent. The official MCP Server for Enterprise (preview) only runs read-only Entra directory queries.

rate_limits.summary: Global 130,000 requests/10s per app across tenants; service-specific limits apply; 429 with Retry-After

entries.name: monday.com API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: <personal API token or OAuth2 token>
entries.free_tier: free tier: GraphQL API included on Free plan (rate limited)
entries.desc_en: Query and update monday.com boards, items, and workflows via GraphQL API or a hosted MCP endpoint.
entries.notes: Hosted MCP accepts a personal API token or OAuth 2.0; SSE transport is deprecated in favor of Streamable HTTP.

free_plan.quota: Free plan: 1,000 API calls/day; 1M complexity points/min

rate_limits.summary: Complexity 10M points/min per personal token (1M on trial/free); Free plan 1,000 calls/day reset midnight UTC

entries.name: NocoDB Cloud API
entries.auth_hint: REST: 'xc-token: <API_TOKEN>' header; MCP: 'x-api-key: <MCP_TOKEN>' header or OAuth sign-in
entries.free_tier: Free plan: 1,000 records, 1 GB storage, 1,000 API calls/month, 3 editors, 100 automation runs; no credit card
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent read, create and update records, tables and views in NocoDB spreadsheet-style databases.
entries.notes: Free plan API quota is very small (1,000 calls/month). v3 Data API reference at https://data-apis-v3.nocodb.com/ and Meta API at https://meta-apis-v3.nocodb.com/. Remote MCP over Streamable HTTP; tools follow the token owner's base role and plan-gated features.

free_plan.quota: 1,000 API calls, 1,000 records, 1 GB storage, 3 editors

entries.name: Notion API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <integration token or OAuth2 token>
entries.free_tier: free, API access included on all plans (rate limit ~3 req/sec)
entries.desc_en: Read, create, and update Notion pages, databases, and comments via REST API.
entries.notes: Internal integrations use static tokens; public integrations use OAuth2. Official hosted MCP endpoint requires sign-in (returns 401 unauthenticated).

rate_limits.summary: 180 requests/min per connection (600/min on Business/Enterprise) plus per-workspace limits; 429 with Retry-After

call.operation: create a page under an existing page
call.example:
curl -X POST https://api.notion.com/v1/pages -H "Authorization: Bearer $NOTION_API_KEY" -H 'Notion-Version: 2026-03-11' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"parent": {"page_id": "{page_id}"}, "properties": {"title": {"title": [{"text": {"content": "New page"}}]}}, "markdown": "# Hello

First paragraph"}'

entries.name: Todoist API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <API token or OAuth2 token>
entries.free_tier: free to use; some features gated by the user's Todoist plan
entries.desc_en: Create, read, and complete Todoist tasks and projects via REST API or the official MCP server.
entries.notes: Official MCP works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code; supports OAuth dynamic client registration (RFC 7591).

rate_limits.summary: Per user: 1,000 partial sync requests and 100 full sync requests per 15 minutes; up to 100 commands per request

entries.name: Trello API
entries.auth_hint: key=<API_KEY>&token=<API_TOKEN> query params, or Authorization: OAuth oauth_consumer_key="<API_KEY>", oauth_token="<API_TOKEN>"
entries.free_tier: free, no key needed to register an app; usage is rate limited
entries.desc_en: Create and manage Trello boards, lists, and cards via REST API.
entries.notes: Now documented under the Atlassian developer platform; REST calls send an API key plus a user token (no Bearer). The official MCP server uses OAuth 2.0 and works on all Trello plans.

rate_limits.summary: 300 requests/10s per API key; 100 requests/10s per token; /1/members 100 requests/900s
